works.body:
It is nice to meet you.
I was so impressed by the taste and coolness of your work that I thought it would be nice if you could draw it for me...so I sent you a request.

She is a tough and belligerent female mercenary in her mid-30s who uses a large sword. She is basically a self-possessed person, but she has a very capricious and bestial temperament. I would like her to have a fearless expression with no highlights in her eyes, but I would be happy if B@lom could draw her as she pleases.
https://x.com/domitaorurosan/status/1988553790744641811?t=zC_2tesPs_h50eZ3u20PPw&s=19

Thank you very much for your consideration.

Hello, sensei. Your art is beautiful. Please draw my character.

Klaus is an older man and the boss of an alcohol company.
He is rich, charming, talkative and smug.
But he is also a volatile, pathetic and possessive man who indulges far too much within his obsessions, such as his daughter, Autumn. (The brunette girl.)


His themes: Victorian gothic, Alice in wonderland, Europe, money, deer, October, denpa.

feel free to choose any poses, or new outfits. Also, if you have any rough drafts or preliminary drawings, I would be happy to have them.

Reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rxF7Dpd5nBO8qwJJSOhUsUYBL63lqQ61

Can you draw my OC?
Late 30's to early 40's in age, hardened but energetic.
Hair has a few grey streaks. Hair is often messy, combed back by his own fingers and nothing more.
He is of lower rank, but is mostly loyal to the cause. He will follow all commands as given, but also appreciates the lack of responsibility that comes from his lower rank - he uses his lack of responsibility to pursue fun or relaxation, when not on duty.
Slow to ready his firearm, but quick to fire once ready.
Very direct in actions, no capacity for subtlety or underhanded double-dealing. His emotions are simple and open, he does not bother to hide or repress himself.
He can find genuine enjoyment in common operations, he acknowledges both the general hell around him but also the small bright moments that life presents.
Draw as you wish, any scenario. I have always been happy with your freedom.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Kw7ADGsL1r44hAXxyi8XwFEdrbHbvjRH

Hello, I want my Fox OC to be drawn by your style.
He's a slightly flirty but serious private detective, you can draw him in a light grey suit and a blue tie.
For his pose, make sure he his smoking his cigarette.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FQpSdQiftApq8SG2UqjFeqc58AMNloq3?usp=drive_link

Thank you for considering my request!

Hello,
I would love for you to draw Amiya.
She is a sweet and sometimes mischevious spider girl!
Here is the character reference:
https://twitter.com/amiyaaranha/status/1716507535857922077

For this drawing, I would like it to be 1920s themed. For the appearance, the key points are the short curly hair, hat or hair accessory, and the flapper style dress. Please  see the below pictures for reference:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1GjpieFbp08FaadJmHBjuoR2XxvaCggnT/view?usp=sharing

Perhaps she could be looking in a vanity applying lipstick and perfume, with makeup or perfume bottles on the table?

Please note that her spider legs, and corset piercings on the chest and thigh are very important to include. If you are not able to include these, feel free to decline this request! 

Please provide a psd and transparent png. I may use this art for Youtube, Twitter, and other SNS.

Hi! I have been stunned by the quality of your work and would like to have a commission done of my OC Jossaline who is a cowgirl with the ears and tail of a coyote! Her personality is typically bubbly, jovial, and mischievous, but can be compassionate and caring when the time is needed.
I would like the character to be conveying a comforting atmosphere. As if the viewer is at home relaxing together.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/193zv8ncy1wgA3n7D7L11KBNWkW4LGvIr?usp=sharing

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/193zv8ncy1wgA3n7D7L11KBNWkW4LGvIr?usp=sharing

Hello! Could i ask you to draw my arctic fox?

He is a quiet and slightly mysterious man. He runs a bar, but in addition to working as a bartender he also secretly sells firearms through the bar. So he has a slightly shady personality!

You can feel free to draw him in any clothes and with any hairstyle you want. You can either use an outfit from the references, or make something new. The pose and composition is up to you. The important thing is to have fun drawing!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/125sVh28UN5A3mpArhRNobv3dz-4fn7Eg?usp=drive_link

Hi there, I love your art! ❤️❤️
I would love if you could draw my OC, Jonah. He is a 44 year old private investigator with a cranky yet also loyal personality.
It would be great if you could put him in a tense feeling action pose, maybe reaching for his gun under his trench coat? Or anything with a cool demeanor would be fine, actually. 
Thanks so much for your consideration! 
Reference: https://toyhou.se/23410483.jonah-lewis#75804421 
Profile page: https://toyhou.se/23410483.jonah-lewis
Notes: He has a scar over one of his eyes, rendering himself unable to open it fully. He almost always wears sunglasses to hide it! He also often forgets to shave due to stress, so he has stubble.
Thanks so much again!! 💞

Hello! I would like to request art of my vampire OC, Libra. You can choose the pose and details, I would just like the piece to have a pretty but somber atmosphere. 

Libra is a nobleman vampire. He has partial amnesia and has forgotten a crucial year of his life. Thirty years later, he is a much more somber, isolated person, trying to reconnect with his old companions. He is weak to silver, fears needles, and is suspicious of mirrors. 

Below are various references with examples of his typical outfits. The first reference is a bit suggestive but captures him best. His face marks are optional. He has a scar on his left hip from an old hunt. Thank you for your time!

Ref 1: https://toyhou.se/2061814.libra-melia/gallery#68167888

Ref 2: https://toyhou.se/2061814.libra-melia/gallery#75057469

Ref 3: https://toyhou.se/2061814.libra-melia/gallery#77846520

Ref 4: https://toyhou.se/2061814.libra-melia/gallery#76332749

Ref 5: https://toyhou.se/2061814.libra-melia/gallery#80358523

Could you draw my two OCs?

A: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CviyDhJIriTGHGyr728xtxTL52qUH73S
B: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1c5HDUO8a5oD2foupHQVDRuSvQP0AhPB3

They stand close together, and each has a hand on the other's shoulder. They are making an obvious show of their comradery to a common enemy. 
There has been some alcohol consumption, and their emotions are intensified by the inebriation. 
Two friends who are normally calm, displaying a burst of expression to their enemy. 

"A" should have a smug and challenging expression, showing haughty confidence in their victory.
"B" should have a wild and crazy expression, almost joyful but clearly unhinged, enthusiastically prepared for violence.

Do as you wish with all else. 

Please appeal if price is the only concern.

Hello! Your art looks fantastic! I was wondering if I could request a Furry AU art of my and my friend's OCs! Specifically, they are our intepretations of Romance of the Three Kingdoms Figures. I'd love to see Xiahou Dun (https://i.imgur.com/uGS2Yrj.png) and Xun Yu (https://i.imgur.com/dwHAsLL.jpeg) together! Xiahou Dun appears like an aggressive wolf but despite his temper he's very loyal and a softie. Xun Yu, on the other hand, appears elegant but extremely straightforward about his affection. I'll include both the references to their human and furry forms in the album, but I leave the pose, clothing, and composition up to you!

https://imgur.com/a/vauENeT

Thank you for considering me. 

Please feel free to cancel the request if you do not feel like it or if the price is not suitable.

Hello. I love the way you draw men. I would love to request my character.

He is a middle-aged doctor with a calm and friendly demeanor, but he is actually a serial killer. Please note his purple eyelids.

Please draw him as you wish.

Thank you for your consideration!

https://f2.toyhou.se/file/f2-toyhou-se/images/70371958_IXv0M1LxYupmt2D.png?1700284823

Hello! I really like your art. I'd like you to draw my TRPG OC. He's a halfling (https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%8F%E3%83%BC%E3%83%95%E3%83%AA%E3%83%B3%E3%82%B0) paladin/bard who plays the lute. He uses rapiers to fight and perform with. He loves to play music for others and to explore. Please note his burn scar on his face. You can draw him in any pose and in any clothes. Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xgweyk5FBURhg3vnNTyShgCxPUgKyIn_?usp=drive_link

私のOCを描いていただけませんか？

-とても青白い肌で、わずかにピンクや紫がかっている。奇妙でエイリアンに見える。
-明るいヘーゼル色の目。
-小さな尖った角ばった鼻。
-唇は普通の肌の色に近い。
-顎のラインは角ばっているが、顎は小さく丸みを帯びている。
-耳はほとんど平らで、部分的に髪に覆われている。
-黒髪で、頭から後ろに櫛が入っている。肩より上の長さで、少し不揃いにカットされている。髪質は細く、ひょろひょろしている。生え際は浅いピーク。

服装
-ハイネックのシャツ、灰色がかった紺色。襟には明るいシルバーの装飾。長袖で、袖の裾に明るい銀色の装飾がある。開閉は中央ではなく脇にある。
-黒い手袋は背中に硬い金属が付いている。
-右耳は軟骨の縁の上にシルバーのイヤーカフ。
-両耳に銀のピアス。

性格
-自己満足的で飄々としている。他人の意見を気にせず、自分が正しいと信じることに向かって独自に行動する。冷静に面白がっているように見せかけ、周囲の世界は自分には関係のないただの娯楽であるかのように振る舞うが、その仮面の裏では非常に観察力が鋭く、計算高い。非常に支配的な振る舞いをする。自分が関わるどんな状況でもコントロールしようとし、観察力を駆使してできるだけ多くの情報を得て利用しようとする。気にかける人は少ないが、非常に強い独占欲を持つ。

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hmWvDjGd7yj3fTG0jZDk8UC2-mR5Lg0Q

Hello there!

Would you please draw my character, Lawrence? He's a vampire cowboy! He looks rather cocky and vicious on the outside, but is actually a very warmhearted and gentle father to a young girl. He's very muscular and rugged, with large, intimidating fangs and sharp claws.

I don't have any preference on pose or expression, I'd like to leave that up to you!

Thank you so much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HnCnFmza3JzOnzvGLjQUdAHXEGGt_M-g?usp=sharing

Hello!

I would like to request an illustration of one of my TTRPG characters, Seylanar. I have included a link to his reference picture.

He is a divine unicorn who lost his horn to monster hunters as a child, causing him to be trapped in human form. He was exiled from his people because of this, and lives a fairly lonely existence as a witch driven largely by anger and vengeance. Though he is not incapable of being kind or reasonable, he is merciless to those who he believes are in the wrong and many people fear him for this.

Important Features
- Wears his horn on a necklace 
- X-shaped stitch like scars running down his forehead and below his nose 
- Faint white markings on skin

As long as the details are there, you are free to draw him in with any pose/expression/outfit you would like!

Thank you!

https://f2.toyhou.se/file/f2-toyhou-se/images/28672378_SYlPSnYa4vUFdHu.png?1688315899

Hello, nice to meet you ばろむ様. I really love your art work and would appreciate it if you would be willing to draw my original character. 

🪓 Jeff (38, 189cm) A quiet and submissive man. He's actually a sociopathic serial killer but can be totally harmless in normal day life. His main job is janitor. 
His usual facial expression is emotionless or smiling. 

I don’t have any specific requirement so I’ll leave the details to you if that's ok. Feel free to adjust his appearance and outfit as you like. 

Thank you for considering me! 

Please feel free to cancel the request if you do not feel like it or if the price is not suitable.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ALlO2SBvIF3V0nNnDr_N0Gb1n76qi0oU?usp=drive_link

Nice meeting you! Could you please draw my TTRPG OC "Cormornt"? 

He is a bounty hunter/pirate, of fantasy North African / Egyptian / Moor ancestry. He has amber eyes, tanned skin, dark wild hair, a short stubble beard, many scars. He hunts sea monsters, other pirates, and political rivals. He uses a rifle and fishing knives. He is a man of few words, introspective, moody, but polite. He loves artwork and is bisexual. He is currently working for a crew based in a fantasy Venice. 
 
The clothes, pose, expression, and details are up to you. Please feel free to combine outfit inspirations or design the clothes freely, so long as he looks like a bounty hunter native to a desert-like place.

Thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/XRVycpq

こんにちは！
SKEBのトップページであなたの作品を見て、
あなたのスタイルで私のキャラクターを描いていただきたいと思っています。
私のリクエストを考慮していただければ幸いです。
【キャラクターについて】
186cm(狼耳含む)、20歳前半。４耳亞人、右の狼耳が欠けており。
紺色髪、ギザ歯、健康な褐色肌。

ここまでお読み、私のリクエストを考慮していただければ幸いです、
本当にありがとうございます！

もしよろしければ、私のOCを描いていただけませんか？

特徴は？
-オレンジがかった茶髪。
-髪の長さは鼻の下くらい。髪の束が少し抜けている。
-ティール色の目
-両耳に2つのイヤリング、1つは銅にはめ込まれたアメジスト、もう1つはすべて銅。
-アンダーシャツの襟の一番上のボタンは外したまま。
-襟の両脇のボタンは銅とトパーズの飾りピンで留めてある。

他人が犯した罪のために不当に不死を強要され、あらゆるものが変化し廃れていくのを見届けるのに費やした長い年月が彼を疲弊させた。無気力で退屈なことが多く、周囲の何事にも興味がない。比較的短期間で変化が見られるようなことには力を入れようとしないため、怠け者で自己中心的に見える。薬物や暴力的な戦闘に憂さ晴らしを求めることもある。努力や感情を発揮するのは、短時間で、しかも強く爆発させるときだけである。

お好きなように描いてください！

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CviyDhJIriTGHGyr728xtxTL52qUH73S

Hello, nice to meet you!
If you don't mind, could you please draw my original character Yuta-kun?
He looks cute, but he is a male character of a visual-kei band member.
https://toyhou.se/17623732.yuta

The character has many expressions of joy, anger, sadness, and anger, and I personally would like to see him in many different expressions, so any expression is fine!
Also, although he is a bassist, we have not decided on a bass design, so if you do decide to draw him, please feel free to draw him however you like.

For the delivery, I would be happy to have a psd file with all the addresses/backgrounds/characters etc. separated as much as possible.

We will leave all composition, theme, etc. to you, so please draw as you wish.
If necessary, I can draw Yuta's band member and high school junior, vocalist Dely, together.
I have written a little about the relationship in a past request, so please refer to that.
https://skeb.jp/@umaneko/works/41
